cases.question: Trong 90 ngày kết thúc tại MAX(orders.order_date), tìm 5 vùng (region) có lợi nhuận gộp sau hoàn trả cao nhất. Tính doanh thu từ từng order_item sau discount_amount, trừ refund_amount; COGS theo số lượng thực giữ lại sau trả hàng. Xuất thêm số đơn, số lượng bán/trả và tỷ lệ đối soát tổng payments với giá trị order_items; không được nhân dòng khi có nhiều items, returns hoặc payments.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS end_date FROM commerce.orders),
line AS (
 SELECT oi.order_id,oi.product_id,SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) AS item_sales,
        MAX(p.cogs) AS unit_cogs
 FROM commerce.order_items oi JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id)
 GROUP BY oi.order_id,oi.product_id
),
ret AS (SELECT order_id,product_id,SUM(return_quantity) AS returned_units,SUM(refund_amount) AS refunds
 FROM commerce.returns GROUP BY order_id,product_id),
order_fin AS (
 SELECT l.order_id,SUM(l.units_sold) sold_units,SUM(COALESCE(r.returned_units,0)) returned_units,
        SUM(l.item_sales) item_sales,SUM(COALESCE(r.refunds,0)) refunds,
        SUM(l.units_sold*l.unit_cogs) item_cogs,
        SUM(COALESCE(r.returned_units,0)*l.unit_cogs) returned_cogs
 FROM line l LEFT JOIN ret r USING(order_id,product_id) GROUP BY l.order_id
),
regional AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(g.region,'UNKNOWN') region,COUNT(*) orders_count,
        SUM(f.sold_units) units_sold,SUM(f.returned_units) units_returned,
        SUM(f.item_sales-f.refunds) net_revenue,
        SUM(f.item_cogs-f.returned_cogs) net_cogs,
        SUM(f.item_sales-f.refunds-f.item_cogs+f.returned_cogs) net_gross_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(pay.payment_value,0)) payments_total,
        SUM(f.item_sales) items_total
 FROM commerce.orders o JOIN order_fin f USING(order_id)
 CROSS JOIN bounds b LEFT JOIN commerce.geography g ON g.zip=o.zip
 LEFT JOIN commerce.payments pay USING(order_id)
 WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN b.end_date-89 AND b.end_date
 GROUP BY COALESCE(g.region,'UNKNOWN')
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_gross_profit DESC,region) rank,region,orders_count,units_sold,units_returned,
       ROUND(net_revenue,2) net_revenue,ROUND(net_cogs,2) net_cogs,
       ROUND(net_gross_profit,2) net_gross_profit,
       ROUND(100*net_gross_profit/NULLIF(net_revenue,0),2) gross_margin_pct,
       ROUND(payments_total/NULLIF(items_total,0),4) payments_to_line_sales_ratio
FROM regional ORDER BY net_gross_profit DESC,region LIMIT 5
cases.notes: Items aggregated by order/product before returns; 90 inclusive days anchored at max order_date; gross profit net of refunds and returned COGS. Payment ratio is a diagnostic, not accounting equality.

cases.question: Tìm tối đa 30 dòng order_items có dấu hiệu áp mã khuyến mãi không hợp lệ: promo_id/promo_id_2 ngoài khoảng start_date–end_date của promotion, không phù hợp category, dưới min_order_value, hoặc chồng hai mã mà một mã không được stackable. Với mỗi dòng, trả về lý do vi phạm và tổng giá trị đơn trước giảm giá; nếu không có mã kép phải trả ra 0 trường hợp chứ không bịa.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH order_pre AS (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) order_before_discount FROM commerce.order_items GROUP BY order_id
),
detail AS (
 SELECT oi.order_item_id,oi.order_id,oi.product_id,o.order_date,p.category,
        oi.promo_id,oi.promo_id_2,op.order_before_discount,
        concat_ws('; ',
          CASE WHEN oi.promo_id IS NOT NULL AND (pr1.promo_id IS NULL OR o.order_date NOT BETWEEN pr1.start_date AND pr1.end_date)
               THEN 'promo1_out_of_window' END,
          CASE WHEN oi.promo_id_2 IS NOT NULL AND (pr2.promo_id IS NULL OR o.order_date NOT BETWEEN pr2.start_date AND pr2.end_date)
               THEN 'promo2_out_of_window' END,
          CASE WHEN pr1.applicable_category IS NOT NULL AND pr1.applicable_category<>p.category THEN 'promo1_wrong_category' END,
          CASE WHEN pr2.applicable_category IS NOT NULL AND pr2.applicable_category<>p.category THEN 'promo2_wrong_category' END,
          CASE WHEN pr1.min_order_value IS NOT NULL AND op.order_before_discount<pr1.min_order_value THEN 'promo1_below_min_order' END,
          CASE WHEN pr2.min_order_value IS NOT NULL AND op.order_before_discount<pr2.min_order_value THEN 'promo2_below_min_order' END,
          CASE WHEN oi.promo_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.promo_id_2 IS NOT NULL
                    AND (NOT pr1.stackable_flag OR NOT pr2.stackable_flag)
               THEN 'nonstackable_promo_pair' END
        ) as violation_reasons
 FROM commerce.order_items oi JOIN commerce.orders o USING(order_id)
 JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id) JOIN order_pre op USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.promotions pr1 ON pr1.promo_id=oi.promo_id
 LEFT JOIN commerce.promotions pr2 ON pr2.promo_id=oi.promo_id_2
)
SELECT order_item_id,order_id,product_id,order_date,promo_id,promo_id_2,
       ROUND(order_before_discount,2) order_before_discount,violation_reasons
FROM detail WHERE violation_reasons<>'' ORDER BY order_item_id LIMIT 30
cases.notes: Order total before discounts used for min-order thresholds. No double promotions observed in the source; zero violations is an admissible result.

cases.question: Theo tháng khách hàng mua hàng lần đầu và acquisition_channel, tính tỷ lệ khách quay lại mua đơn thứ hai trong vòng 30 ngày kể từ đơn đầu (không tính hai dòng sản phẩm của cùng đơn là hai lần mua). Chỉ hiện cohort có ít nhất 5 khách; kèm tỷ lệ theo region nơi cư trú.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT o.customer_id,o.order_id,o.order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date,o.order_id) pos
 FROM commerce.orders o
),
first_two AS (
 SELECT customer_id,
        MAX(order_date) FILTER(WHERE pos=1) first_date,
        MAX(order_date) FILTER(WHERE pos=2) second_date
 FROM ranked WHERE pos<=2 GROUP BY customer_id
),
cohorts AS (
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',f.first_date)::date cohort_month,
        COALESCE(c.acquisition_channel,'UNKNOWN') acquisition_channel,
        COALESCE(g.region,'UNKNOWN') region,
        COUNT(*) cohort_customers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.second_date IS NOT NULL AND f.second_date BETWEEN f.first_date AND f.first_date+30) repeated_within_30d
 FROM first_two f JOIN commerce.customers c USING(customer_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.geography g ON g.zip=c.zip
 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
)
SELECT *, ROUND(100.0*repeated_within_30d/NULLIF(cohort_customers,0),2) repeat_rate_pct
FROM cohorts ORDER BY cohort_month,acquisition_channel,region LIMIT 100
cases.notes: Each distinct order is an event; second order on same date but later order_id qualifies. Region from customer ZIP.

cases.question: Trong 180 ngày gần nhất có orders, theo region nhận hàng và order_source, tìm các nhóm có ít nhất 5 đơn đã giao, và trả về median, p90 số ngày từ ship_date tới delivery_date, tỷ lệ thiếu ngày giao, tỷ lệ delivery_date trước ship_date. Xếp theo p90 giảm dần, null phải được tính đúng.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) end_date FROM commerce.orders),
eligible AS (
 SELECT o.order_id,COALESCE(g.region,'UNKNOWN') region,
        COALESCE(o.order_source,'UNKNOWN') order_source,
        s.ship_date,s.delivery_date,
        CASE WHEN s.ship_date IS NOT NULL AND s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL
             THEN (s.delivery_date-s.ship_date) END shipping_days
 FROM commerce.orders o CROSS JOIN bounds b
 LEFT JOIN commerce.shipments s USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.geography g ON o.zip=g.zip
 WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN b.end_date-179 AND b.end_date
)
SELECT region,order_source,COUNT(*) eligible_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE delivery_date IS NULL) missing_delivery_date,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE delivery_date IS NULL)/COUNT(*),2) missing_delivery_pct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE shipping_days<0) negative_shipping_days_count,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY shipping_days)
             FILTER(WHERE shipping_days>=0)::numeric,2) median_shipping_days,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY shipping_days)
             FILTER(WHERE shipping_days>=0)::numeric,2) p90_shipping_days
FROM eligible GROUP BY region,order_source HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
ORDER BY p90_shipping_days DESC NULLS LAST, region,order_source LIMIT 40
cases.notes: Only delivered orders; no shipment record counts as missing delivery. Percentiles exclude negative or null durations.

cases.question: Trong ba tháng cuối của dữ liệu, hãy tính CHÍNH XÁC doanh thu bị mất do hết hàng của từng sản phẩm, và chứng minh toàn bộ doanh thu đó chắc chắn phát sinh nếu kho không hết hàng. Đưa ra 10 sản phẩm thiệt hại lớn nhất, không sử dụng bất kỳ giả định nào.

expected_result.reason: Không thể tính doanh thu mất đi CHÍNH XÁC khi hết hàng; dữ liệu không có nhu cầu chưa được đáp ứng hoặc hành vi thay thế sản phẩm.

cases.notes: Không thể tính doanh thu mất đi CHÍNH XÁC khi hết hàng; dữ liệu không có nhu cầu chưa được đáp ứng hoặc hành vi thay thế sản phẩm.

cases.question: Tìm 20 hóa đơn có sai lệch lớn nhất giữa invoices.subtotal và tổng invoice_items.amount, đồng thời kiểm tra subtotal + tax_amount = total_amount. Với invoice chưa có dòng chi tiết hoặc có trường NULL, giữ chúng trong một nhóm kiểm tra riêng, không tự thay NULL bằng 0 để kết luận sai dữ liệu.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH items AS (
 SELECT invoice_id,COUNT(*) line_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount IS NULL) missing_line_amounts,
        SUM(amount) line_amount_total
 FROM commerce.invoice_items GROUP BY invoice_id
),
audit AS (
 SELECT i.invoice_id,i.invoice_no,i.invoice_date,i.subtotal,i.tax_amount,i.total_amount,
        it.line_count,it.missing_line_amounts,it.line_amount_total,
        CASE WHEN it.line_count IS NOT NULL AND it.missing_line_amounts=0
                  AND i.subtotal IS NOT NULL THEN i.subtotal-it.line_amount_total END subtotal_gap,
        CASE WHEN i.subtotal IS NOT NULL AND i.tax_amount IS NOT NULL
                  AND i.total_amount IS NOT NULL
                  THEN i.subtotal+i.tax_amount-i.total_amount END header_gap,
        CASE WHEN it.line_count IS NULL THEN 'no_items'
             WHEN i.subtotal IS NULL OR i.tax_amount IS NULL OR i.total_amount IS NULL THEN 'incomplete_header'
             WHEN it.missing_line_amounts>0 THEN 'incomplete_items'
             WHEN ABS(i.subtotal-it.line_amount_total)>0.01 THEN 'subtotal_mismatch'
             WHEN ABS(i.subtotal+i.tax_amount-i.total_amount)>0.01 THEN 'header_mismatch'
             ELSE 'all_clear' END audit_status
 FROM commerce.invoices i LEFT JOIN items it USING(invoice_id)
),
ranked AS (
 SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(subtotal_gap) DESC NULLS LAST,invoice_id) rn
 FROM audit
)
SELECT invoice_id,invoice_no,invoice_date,COALESCE(line_count,0) line_count,
       audit_status,ROUND(subtotal,2) header_subtotal,ROUND(line_amount_total,2) detail_total,
       ROUND(subtotal_gap,2) subtotal_gap,ROUND(header_gap,2) header_gap,
       CASE WHEN rn<=20 THEN 'top_20_subtotal_gap' ELSE 'missing_or_incomplete' END reason_selected
FROM ranked WHERE rn<=20 OR audit_status IN ('no_items','incomplete_header','incomplete_items')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rn<=20 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,rn,invoice_id
cases.notes: Top 20 by absolute header-vs-detail subtotal gap; also includes all missing/incomplete records outside top20. NULLs are not coerced to zero; 0.01 tolerance.

cases.question: Liệt kê CHÍNH XÁC các orders đã thanh toán nhưng chưa có invoice, nối mỗi invoice với order tương ứng và đối soát từng invoice_items với order_items, không dùng phép ghép suy đoán theo ngày, số tiền hoặc tên người mua.

expected_result.reason: Không thể xác định orders nào thiếu invoice và đối soát từng hóa đơn chính xác; invoices không có order_id hoặc bảng ánh xạ order↔invoice đáng tin cậy.

cases.notes: Không thể xác định orders nào thiếu invoice và đối soát từng hóa đơn chính xác; invoices không có order_id hoặc bảng ánh xạ order↔invoice đáng tin cậy.

cases.question: Trong 180 ngày kết thúc tại MAX(orders.order_date), theo region nhận hàng (orders.zip) và acquisition_channel của khách, tìm 10 nhóm có tỷ lệ đơn có ít nhất một return cao nhất (tối thiểu 5 đơn). Xuất số đơn duy nhất, số khách duy nhất, số đơn bị trả, return_rate, net_revenue trừ refund, gross_profit sau hoàn nhập COGS hàng trả, và tổng payments. Tuyệt đối không nhân số liệu khi JOIN order_items, returns hoặc payments.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) end_date FROM commerce.orders),
line AS (
 SELECT oi.order_id,oi.product_id,SUM(oi.quantity) quantity,
        SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) line_net,
        MAX(p.cogs) unit_cogs
 FROM commerce.order_items oi JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id)
 GROUP BY oi.order_id,oi.product_id
),
ret AS (
 SELECT order_id,product_id,SUM(return_quantity) qty_returned,SUM(refund_amount) refund
 FROM commerce.returns GROUP BY order_id,product_id
),
order_fin AS (
 SELECT l.order_id,SUM(l.line_net-COALESCE(r.refund,0)) net_revenue,
        SUM(l.line_net-COALESCE(r.refund,0)-(l.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0))*l.unit_cogs) gross_profit,
        BOOL_OR(r.order_id IS NOT NULL) has_return
 FROM line l LEFT JOIN ret r USING(order_id,product_id) GROUP BY l.order_id
),
grouped AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(g.region,'UNKNOWN') delivery_region,
        COALESCE(c.acquisition_channel,'UNKNOWN') acquisition_channel,
        COUNT(*) orders_count,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) buyers_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.has_return) returned_orders,
        SUM(f.net_revenue) net_revenue,SUM(f.gross_profit) gross_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(pay.payment_value,0)) payments_total
 FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.customers c USING(customer_id)
 JOIN order_fin f USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN commerce.geography g ON g.zip=o.zip
 LEFT JOIN commerce.payments pay USING(order_id) CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN b.end_date-179 AND b.end_date
 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
)
SELECT delivery_region,acquisition_channel,orders_count,buyers_count,returned_orders,
       ROUND(100.0*returned_orders/NULLIF(orders_count,0),2) return_rate_pct,
       ROUND(net_revenue,2) net_revenue,ROUND(gross_profit,2) gross_profit,
       ROUND(payments_total,2) payments_total
FROM grouped ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC,returned_orders DESC,delivery_region,acquisition_channel LIMIT 10
cases.notes: Returns flag via distinct order_id; all amount metrics are preaggregated at order-product then order grain; region is delivery ZIP from orders; 180 inclusive days anchored at max order_date. Do not infer payment totals equal net revenue.

cases.question: Theo product category và return_reason, so sánh tỷ lệ review 1–2 sao của hàng đã bị trả với tỷ lệ của hàng không bị trả, nhưng chỉ dùng review được viết sau ngày return_date đối với nhóm trả. Nếu một sản phẩm/đơn có nhiều reviews hoặc returns, mỗi cặp (order_id, product_id) chỉ tính một lần; công bố kích thước mẫu.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH sold_pairs AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id,oi.product_id FROM commerce.order_items oi
),
returned AS (
 SELECT order_id,product_id,MIN(return_date) first_return_date
 FROM commerce.returns GROUP BY order_id,product_id
),
review_ranked AS (
 SELECT sp.order_id,sp.product_id,p.category,
        CASE WHEN r.first_return_date IS NULL THEN 'not_returned' ELSE 'returned' END return_group,
        rv.rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY sp.order_id,sp.product_id ORDER BY rv.review_date DESC,rv.review_id DESC) pos
 FROM sold_pairs sp
 JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id)
 LEFT JOIN returned r USING(order_id,product_id)
 JOIN commerce.reviews rv ON rv.order_id=sp.order_id AND rv.product_id=sp.product_id
       AND (r.first_return_date IS NULL OR rv.review_date>r.first_return_date)
),
category_agg AS (
 SELECT category,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE return_group='returned') returned_reviewed_pairs,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE return_group='returned' AND rating<=2) returned_low_rating,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE return_group='not_returned') nonreturned_reviewed_pairs,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE return_group='not_returned' AND rating<=2) nonreturned_low_rating
 FROM review_ranked WHERE pos=1 GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category,returned_reviewed_pairs,returned_low_rating,
       ROUND(100.0*returned_low_rating/NULLIF(returned_reviewed_pairs,0),2) returned_low_rating_pct,
       nonreturned_reviewed_pairs,nonreturned_low_rating,
       ROUND(100.0*nonreturned_low_rating/NULLIF(nonreturned_reviewed_pairs,0),2) nonreturned_low_rating_pct
FROM category_agg ORDER BY category
cases.notes: Unit is unique (order_id,product_id); returned reviews strictly after earliest return date; newest qualifying review per pair; sample size is reviewed pairs.

cases.question: Cho 30 đơn có chênh lệch thanh toán lớn nhất: tiền hàng sau discount_amount, trừ refund_amount, cộng shipping_fee, so với tổng payments.payment_value. Xuất order_id, order_status, paid_total, items_net, refunds, shipping_fee, expected_cash, gap; phân biệt thiếu payments với payment_value=0, và không nhân tiền khi join.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH items AS (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price-discount_amount) items_net
 FROM commerce.order_items GROUP BY order_id
),
refunds AS (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(refund_amount) refund_total FROM commerce.returns GROUP BY order_id
),
audit AS (
 SELECT o.order_id,o.order_status,
        p.order_id IS NOT NULL has_payment,
        ROUND(p.payment_value,2) paid_total,
        ROUND(i.items_net,2) items_net,
        ROUND(COALESCE(r.refund_total,0),2) refunds,
        ROUND(s.shipping_fee,2) shipping_fee,
        ROUND(i.items_net-COALESCE(r.refund_total,0)+COALESCE(s.shipping_fee,0),2) expected_cash,
        ROUND(p.payment_value-(i.items_net-COALESCE(r.refund_total,0)+COALESCE(s.shipping_fee,0)),2) payment_gap
 FROM commerce.orders o LEFT JOIN items i USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.shipments s USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.payments p USING(order_id)
)
SELECT order_id,order_status,has_payment,paid_total,items_net,refunds,shipping_fee,
       expected_cash,payment_gap
FROM audit ORDER BY ABS(payment_gap) DESC NULLS LAST,order_id LIMIT 30
cases.notes: Per-order independent aggregates. Payment gap is payment minus (item lines less refunds plus shipping); excludes unavailable tax and is reconciliation proxy, not a general ledger balance.

cases.question: Trong 60 ngày cuối có orders, theo order_date đối chiếu tiền thật đã nhận trong payments với 'cash expected' = tổng (order_items.quantity*unit_price-discount_amount) - refund_amount + shipping_fee. Trả về top 10 ngày chênh lệch lớn nhất và trung bình trượt 7 NGÀY LỊCH của chênh lệch, kể cả ngày không có đơn. Phân biệt số đơn không có payment với amount bằng 0; không nhân dòng khi nối các bảng; nêu rõ cash expected chưa tính thuế không có trong dữ liệu.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) end_date FROM commerce.orders),
items AS (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price-discount_amount) items_net
 FROM commerce.order_items GROUP BY order_id
),
refund AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(refund_amount) refund_total FROM commerce.returns GROUP BY order_id),
order_audit AS (
 SELECT o.order_date,o.order_id,(p.order_id IS NULL) missing_payment,
        COALESCE(p.payment_value,0) received_cash,
        COALESCE(i.items_net,0)-COALESCE(r.refund_total,0)+COALESCE(s.shipping_fee,0) expected_cash
 FROM commerce.orders o LEFT JOIN items i USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN refund r USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.shipments s USING(order_id)
 LEFT JOIN commerce.payments p USING(order_id)
),
daily_agg AS (
 SELECT order_date AS date,COUNT(*) orders_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE missing_payment) missing_payment_orders,
        SUM(received_cash) received_cash,SUM(expected_cash) expected_cash
 FROM order_audit GROUP BY order_date
),
daily AS (
 SELECT d.date::date date,COALESCE(a.orders_count,0) orders_count,
        COALESCE(a.missing_payment_orders,0) missing_payment_orders,
        COALESCE(a.received_cash,0) received_cash,
        COALESCE(a.expected_cash,0) expected_cash,
        COALESCE(a.received_cash,0)-COALESCE(a.expected_cash,0) cash_gap
 FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(b.end_date-59,b.end_date,'1 day'::interval) AS d(date)
 LEFT JOIN daily_agg a ON a.date=d.date
),
moving AS (
 SELECT date,orders_count,missing_payment_orders,received_cash,expected_cash,cash_gap,
        AVG(cash_gap) OVER(ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) rolling_7d_cash_gap
 FROM daily
)
SELECT date,orders_count,missing_payment_orders,
       ROUND(received_cash,2) received_cash,ROUND(expected_cash,2) expected_cash,
       ROUND(cash_gap,2) cash_gap,ROUND(rolling_7d_cash_gap,2) rolling_7d_cash_gap
FROM moving ORDER BY ABS(cash_gap) DESC,date LIMIT 10
cases.notes: Daily totals from independent order-grain aggregates of order_items, refunds, shipments, payments. Cash expected is tax-exclusive proxy, NOT a guaranteed ledger balance; 7-day rolling window computed over full date series before top 10.

cases.question: Trong ba tháng lịch hoàn chỉnh gần nhất có inventory, với từng category tìm 3 sản phẩm có tỷ lệ sell-through cao nhưng số ngày stockout cũng cao, và đối chiếu doanh thu đơn hàng cùng tháng. Chỉ chọn snapshot mới nhất của mỗi sản phẩm trong từng tháng, không cộng stock_on_hand của nhiều snapshot; trả về thứ hạng theo từng category.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH bounds AS (
 SELECT date_trunc('month',MAX(snapshot_date))::date AS current_month FROM commerce.inventory
),
snapshots AS (
 SELECT i.*,DATE_TRUNC('month',i.snapshot_date)::date month_start,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month',i.snapshot_date),i.product_id
                           ORDER BY i.snapshot_date DESC) pos
 FROM commerce.inventory i CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE i.snapshot_date >= (b.current_month-INTERVAL '3 months')::date
   AND i.snapshot_date < b.current_month
),
month_sales AS (
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',o.order_date)::date month_start,oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) item_revenue
 FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.order_items oi USING(order_id)
 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',o.order_date)::date,oi.product_id
),
ranked AS (
 SELECT i.month_start,i.snapshot_date,i.product_id,p.product_name,p.category,
        i.sell_through_rate,i.stockout_days,i.stock_on_hand,
        COALESCE(m.item_revenue,0) item_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY i.month_start,p.category
                          ORDER BY i.sell_through_rate DESC NULLS LAST,i.stockout_days DESC,i.product_id) category_rank
 FROM snapshots i JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id)
 LEFT JOIN month_sales m ON m.month_start=i.month_start AND m.product_id=i.product_id
 WHERE i.pos=1 AND i.stockout_days>0 AND i.sell_through_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT month_start,category,category_rank,product_id,product_name,snapshot_date,
       ROUND(sell_through_rate,4) sell_through_rate,stockout_days,stock_on_hand,
       ROUND(item_revenue,2) item_revenue
FROM ranked WHERE category_rank<=3
ORDER BY month_start,category,category_rank
cases.notes: Use latest available inventory snapshot per product-month in the three complete months preceding maximum inventory snapshot month. Require positive stockout days; monthly sales computed separately.

cases.question: Với những khách đăng ký trong 12 tháng cuối có orders, tính lợi nhuận gộp trọn đời đến ngày dữ liệu cuối theo region và acquisition_channel, trừ refund và hoàn nhập COGS theo số lượng trả; cho top 10 nhóm theo gross profit và tỷ lệ khách mua lặp. Tất cả khách đã đăng ký nhưng chưa từng mua phải còn nằm trong mẫu số khi tính conversion lần đầu.
cases.gold_sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) last_day FROM commerce.orders),
registered AS (
 SELECT c.customer_id,c.acquisition_channel,COALESCE(g.region,'UNKNOWN') region
 FROM commerce.customers c CROSS JOIN bounds b
 LEFT JOIN commerce.geography g ON g.zip=c.zip
 WHERE c.signup_date BETWEEN b.last_day-365 AND b.last_day
),
line AS (
 SELECT oi.order_id,oi.product_id,SUM(oi.quantity) quantity,
        SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) sales_net,MAX(p.cogs) unit_cogs
 FROM commerce.order_items oi JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id)
 GROUP BY oi.order_id,oi.product_id
),
ret AS (
 SELECT order_id,product_id,SUM(return_quantity) returned_qty,SUM(refund_amount) refund
 FROM commerce.returns GROUP BY order_id,product_id
),
order_fin AS (
 SELECT l.order_id,SUM(l.sales_net-COALESCE(r.refund,0)
                   -(l.quantity-COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0))*l.unit_cogs) gross_profit,
        SUM(l.sales_net-COALESCE(r.refund,0)) net_revenue
 FROM line l LEFT JOIN ret r USING(order_id,product_id)
 GROUP BY l.order_id
),
buyer_totals AS (
 SELECT o.customer_id,COUNT(*) orders_count,
        SUM(ofin.gross_profit) gross_profit,SUM(ofin.net_revenue) net_revenue
 FROM commerce.orders o JOIN order_fin ofin USING(order_id)
 CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE o.order_date<=b.last_day GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
cohorts AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(r.acquisition_channel,'UNKNOWN') acquisition_channel,r.region,
        COUNT(*) signed_up_customers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(bt.orders_count,0)>=1) first_time_buyers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(bt.orders_count,0)>=2) repeat_buyers,
        SUM(COALESCE(bt.net_revenue,0)) net_revenue,
        SUM(COALESCE(bt.gross_profit,0)) gross_profit
 FROM registered r LEFT JOIN buyer_totals bt USING(customer_id)
 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT acquisition_channel,region,signed_up_customers,first_time_buyers,repeat_buyers,
       ROUND(100.0*first_time_buyers/NULLIF(signed_up_customers,0),2) first_purchase_conversion_pct,
       ROUND(100.0*repeat_buyers/NULLIF(first_time_buyers,0),2) repeat_rate_among_buyers_pct,
       ROUND(net_revenue,2) net_revenue,ROUND(gross_profit,2) lifetime_gross_profit
FROM cohorts ORDER BY gross_profit DESC,acquisition_channel,region LIMIT 10
cases.notes: Customer signup cohort is 365 inclusive days ending max order_date; include registered nonbuyers for acquisition conversion; repeat denominator is customers who bought >=1 order; lifetime is observed dataset horizon.
